verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation is a fair question for a serverless compute platform, but the evidence pack does not document any rule or trigger system that runs actions automatically on events. The HTTPS endpoints and background spawning shown are developer building blocks that require explicit invocation. Workspace budgets are a spend control, an adjacent feature rather than an event rule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
